Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Normal returns: Once an order has been delivered, returns are generally not accepted for change of mind or taste preferences.
Damaged items: These are treated as a shipment issue, not a return. You can report it within 7 days of delivery and provide:
• A photo of the damaged item
• A photo of the packaging and packing slip
• A short description of the issue
You should also keep the item in the condition you received it, as it may be requested for review.
So in short: normal returns are limited after delivery, but damage during shipping is reviewed separately and may be eligible for a resolution after photos are provided.
